title: Quietly Braised Turkish Beef Shin Kebabs
description: A hearty Turkish dish featuring tender beef shin, perfect for a solo dinner, with a crumbly texture and grassy notes from fresh parsley and dill, high in protein and low in carbs, making it friendly for high-protein diets.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the beef shin cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste, beef broth, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Cover the Dutch oven and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the beef shin for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender.
Remove the Dutch oven from the oven and stir in the chopped parsley and dill.
Serve the braised beef shin hot, garnished with additional parsley and dill if desired.
